snippet.title: [100 Free Draws] Infinity Nikki × The Little Prince Collab Trailer
snippet.description:
[100 Free Draws] Infinity Nikki × The Little Prince Collab Trailer 

Look up when a meteor shower streaks across the sky. A wild bird will sweep past with a paintbrush in its beak, a little traveler bound for yet another journey into the unknown.

When the Rose's petals take flight, let us make a promise before the forty-fourth sunset arrives: we will meet upon a certain star.

🪐 Infinity Nikki × The Little Prince Limited-Time Collab
Event Duration: After the Version 2.9 update on September 23, 2026 – November 26, 2026, 12:49 (UTC-7)
Participate in the limited-time collab to claim 100 free draws for the collab Resonance event, plus collab-exclusive rewards including a title, a card, and more! Exclusive collab offers will also be available in the Store!
The new collaboration area "The Little Prince" opens. The collab-exclusive quest "For the Child You Once Were" and world quest "Interstellar Encounters" will be available for a limited time, alongside the limited-time collab event "The Migration of Wild Birds." More adventures and surprises await. See you there, stylists!

🪐 Collab Resonance: A Story Dedicated to Children
Event Duration: After the Version 2.9 update on September 23, 2026 – November 26, 2026, 12:49 (UTC-7)

🌹 Collab Outfit | If Some One Loves a Flower
Main Attribute: Elegant
Outfit Ability: Where Longing Blooms
After using the ability, a vibrant field of roses bursts into bloom at Nikki's feet. Moments later, a paper plane carrying letters from afar floats down to land around her. When Nikki begins to walk, roses bloom along the path. In Ability Setup, the rose effect can be enabled or disabled. When disabled, no roses will appear behind Nikki.
Note: The ability "Where Longing Blooms" cannot be used in certain stages or in the Mira Crown Merit Arena.

Decoration: On His Planet
Can be placed in open spaces. That rose bloomed at sunrise. Her radiant colors, her fragrance, her thorns, and her tenderness gradually filled a child's heart.
❖ Available after reaching 160 Resonances in the limited-time Resonance "A Story Dedicated to Children."

🦊 Collab Outfit | The Little Prince
Main Attribute: Cool
Outfit Ability: Important Thing: Whimsicality
After using the ability, Nikki summons a rain cloud to water the rose. Once the rose has fully grown, the cloud disappears. Nikki then embraces the rose, and her warm embrace transforms into a sturdy glass dome that protects it from harm. If the field of roses created by the Where Longing Blooms ability is nearby, Nikki kisses the letter she has written. Carrying her longing, the letter then drifts on the wind toward the rose field.

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.10 The Feather of Justice launches globally on September 23 (UTC-7)!
#InfinityNikki
#TheFeatherofJustice
